title: Divergence: RATIONALE contract entry claims 'old(_) pre-state bindings' — no old() construct exists anywhere in the language

comments.content: RATIONALE contract Definition: 'ens the postcondition (over a distinguished result binding and old(_) pre-state bindings)'. No 'old' token, AST node, grammar production, or skill entry exists (swept thermite-syntax lexer/parser/ast, thermite-spec grammar/validator, THERMITE.skill.md, thermite-design.md — zero hits). This describes Dafny/Verus, not Thermite — exactly the claim-outruns-the-repo dismissal. Same entry, same fix: first line typo 'Per/postconditions' should be 'Pre/postconditions'.
